SystemTable.name: ddl_engine

SystemTable.name: expand_partition_tasks
SystemTable.Create: create table if not exists `expand_partition_tasks` ( `id` bigint unsigned not null auto_increment, `schema_name` varchar(64) not null default '' comment 'logical schema name', `table_name` varchar(64) not null default '' comment 'logical table name', `table_id` bigint unsigned not null default 0 comment 'physical table id in GMS, used to detect table drop-and-recreate', `initial_partition_count` bigint not null default 0 comment 'C0: partition count when EXPAND was issued', `target_partition_count` bigint not null default 0 comment 'N: desired final partition count', `plan_json` longtext comment 'JSON snapshot of the split plan: items + per-partition status', `status` int not null default 0 comment '0:RUNNING 1:COMPLETED 2:CANCELLED 3:FAILED 4:PAUSED', `completed_partitions` bigint not null default 0 comment 'number of original partitions already split', `pending_partitions` bigint not null default 0 comment 'number of original partitions still to be split', `ddl_job_id` bigint not null default 0 comment 'DDL job id of the underlying EXPAND DDL job', `extra_info` longtext comment 'reserved for future use', `gmt_created` timestamp not null default current_timestamp, `gmt_modified` timestamp not null default current_timestamp on update current_timestamp, primary key (`id`), unique key `uk_schema_table` (`schema_name`, `table_name`) ) charset=utf8mb4 comment='tracks progress of ALTER TABLE ... EXPAND PARTITIONS TO N'
